### God Calls Us to Honor Our Parents - Love Worth Finding - July 27
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-27-2023.html
Passage: Colossians 3:20
Points:
- A person's daily life and conduct either honors or dishonors their parents.
- Scripture directly commands children to obey their parents in all things.
- Seeking to please the Lord requires submitting to parental authority.
- Walking in obedience brings spiritual blessing, while disobedience carries serious danger.
- Believers continue honoring parents in adulthood through respect, advice, and remembrance.

### Husbands, Wives, and Children
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/husbands-wives-and-children
Passage: Colossians 3:18-21
Points:
- The reality of new life in Christ must be demonstrated first within the home.
- Discipleship calls believers to die to self in every daily family interaction.
- Submission and equality coexist without conflict, as demonstrated within the Trinity.
- Paul commands husbands to love without harshness and parents to avoid discouraging children.
- New Testament family ethics are enduring Christian commands rooted in the gospel, not temporary cultural compromises.
